title: Voice Actor Kenjirō Tsuda's TikTok Lawsuit Dismissed After AI-Voiced Videos' Removal
content: The Singaporean company that operates TikTok in Japan reported that the videos had been removed after the lawsuit's November 2025 filing. Thus, the company argued that Tsuda no longer has a legal interest in continuing the case.

title: Muse Asia Licenses Toaru Anbu no Item Anime
content: Muse Asia announced last Friday that it has licensed the television anime of Kazuma Kamachi 's Toaru Anbu no Item (A Certain ITEM of the Dark Side) spinoff novel. The anime will begin streaming in October. The anime will debut in Japan on October 9.

title: My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax! Anime Streams in India
